Current release: O-GlcNAcAtlas 5.0

About the resource

Experimentally identified sites across species

O-GlcNAcAtlas curates protein and site evidence across animals, plants, microbes, fungi, and viruses. Records retain the species, sample, protein, peptide, site, publication, and quantitative context needed for interpretation.

Cite O-GlcNAcAtlas

Ma J. et al. O-GlcNAcAtlas: A database of experimentally identified O-GlcNAc sites and proteins. Glycobiology. 2021, 31(7), 719–723. DOI: 10.1093/glycob/cwab003.

Hou C. et al. O-GlcNAcAtlas 4.0: An Updated Protein O-GlcNAcylation Database with Site-specific Quantification. Journal of Molecular Biology. 2025:169033. DOI: 10.1016/j.jmb.2025.169033.
